title: Evidence for p-wave magnetism in electronic band structure of metallic EuSi
description:
Nature, Published online: 18 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11295-9

A combination of symmetry analysis, first-principles calculations, neutron scattering and photoemission spectroscopy shows p-wave magnetism in the near-Fermi-level electronic structure of stoichiometric metallic EuSi.
